Position: AI/GenAI Engineer (CE50SF RM 4205)

Shift timing : 02 PM to 10 PM
Work Mode : Work From Office
Required Industry Experience : 5+ years of total development experience

Must have skills:

Python,
Azure Function, Open AI Models, AI search,Application insight, LLM Guardrails & Responsible AI,
LangGraph & LangChain; Agentic frameworks; Vector DBs,
Designing and implementing rule engines, business rules, heuristics, and decision-making frameworks,
Knowledge of fuzzy matching techniques, string similarity algorithms, edit distance, and record-linkage methodologies,
Understanding of machine learning concepts, feature engineering, model evaluation,
Work independently, manage priorities, and communicate status, risks, and tradeoffs clearly

Good to have skills:

Experience in Databricks
ML Flow, LangFuse or any observability framework
Git-based workflows (branching, pull requests, code reviews) and Agile/Scrum delivery

Any special or skills related notes:

Hands-on and accountable for delivering working, supportable solutions
Clear communicator who can translate between business needs and technical implementation
Quality-focused (testing, monitoring, documentation) with attention to reliability and maintainability
Calm under pressure when responding to incidents and prioritizing production work

Role focus: LLM + rule-based intelligence
Key responsibilities

Build:
o Fuzzy matching (tokenization/edit distance)
o Rule-based detection (ship-to logic, profile changes)
Develop:
o Why flagged narrative generation based on rule-based output and ML features and output.
o Signal summarization
Implement prompt engineering + guardrails for compliance

Required skills

NLP + prompt engineering
Experience with Azure OpenAI / LLM APIs
Strong understanding of rule engines or heuristics
Understanding of ML models

Job Category: Digital_Cloud_Web Technologies
Job Type: Full Time
Job Location: Pune Ahmedabad Indore
Experience: 5+ years
Notice period: 0-15 days
